preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20,000.
Each test case must have a number of piranhas n between 2 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each piranha size a_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of piranhas across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 or a valid index of a dominant piranha.

postconditions.expression: any(a[i] > a[i-1] or a[i] > a[i+1] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a dominant piranha exists, it must be able to eat at least one adjacent piranha.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if all(a[i] == a[0] for i in range(n)) else True
postconditions.description: If all piranhas have the same size, the output must be -1.
